name: Elastic Grid Center Lag
description: Full-width image grid where each column lags behind the scroll by a different amount, with center columns trailing most, creating an elastic stretching effect on smooth scroll.
contents: Grid of portrait images with optional captions
Optional top and bottom dark gradient overlay
behavior: Items are regrouped into columns, each column gets a scroll lag based on its distance from the center
Columns rebuild when the responsive column count changes on resize
Component fades in once images have loaded
editableByProps: Images and captions, number of items
Colors, padding, gaps, column counts and breakpoint
Lag amount, smoothness, caption visibility and size, overlay

needsCodeEdit.where: aspect-[128/160] class on the data-egscl-img div

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the overlay gradient fade length or darkness
needsCodeEdit.where: linear-gradient background in the overlay div

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with GSAP ScrollSmoother, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Normalizes scroll (normalizeScroll) by default, affecting touch scrolling
Requires gsap with the ScrollSmoother plugin and imagesloaded
